title: slashcapiche
description: the mod basically adds a command /stringcapiche that when typed fills empty slots of inventory with stacks of strings.
body:
brother, i ask many times yet i see no slashstrings mod for 26.1.2, i can assure you if there is no slashstrings mod for 26.1.2 there will be no next time🗿🍷

this mod basically adds a command /stringcapiche when typed and pressed enter, your empty inventory slot gets replaced with a stack of string and a text in chat says "here's some strings.. don't forget tiki tiki phonk next time, capiche?🗿🍷"
